baseline.method: Load exact prior offline ownership function after ASDF initialization; patch manager owns its independently acquired flock.
baseline.invalidInitialHarness: Initial callback called FiveAM fail inside signals-error and falsely passed. Replaced with a nonthrowing entered flag; only corrected baseline counts as evidence.

behavior: Offline maintenance holds serve then patch process locks, nonblocking, without loading journal.
Patch managers share raw safe lock opener; no lock inode unlink/truncate.
Private directory, no-follow regular single-link owner lock, close-on-exec.
Legacy read-only group/other lock bits accepted inside private directory and tightened only after successful ownership.
Failure and callback unwind release ownership.
limitations: This is a consistency prerequisite; operator backup artifact, restore workflow, schedules, retention and remote copies remain open.
Source/loopback tests only; no new native or VM acceptance claimed.
